title: Recovery codes
purpose: Read the unused backup codes for your enrolled two-factor authentication.

items.label: Available count
items.description: Unused codes out of the configured total of ten. A successful recovery-code authentication consumes one code.

items.label: Unused codes
items.description: Read-only text area containing only unused eight-digit codes. Codes can be viewed repeatedly in this deployment; no I have saved my recovery codes checkbox is shown because show-once mode is disabled.

items.label: Download codes
items.description: Shown only with unused codes; downloads recovery-codes.txt containing the unused set. This binary/text attachment has no separate documentation page.

items.label: Generate new codes
items.description: Opens replacement confirmation, available under this deployment’s default reusable-view policy. Generating requires an existing non-recovery authenticator.

sections.title: Access and state
paragraphs: Requires sign-in, an existing recovery-code record and recent reauthentication, normally within five minutes. With no record this page is not found; with zero unused codes it shows the count and an empty list, offers generation and omits download. Accessing this page records that the set has been viewed, but does not consume a code. Keep codes privately outside laboratory records; this page provides no automatic account-recovery procedure if all factors are lost.
